title: Cities in a County Finder: Full Settlement List
description: Find mapped city, town and village nodes in matching county areas; download up to 300 returned points as CSV.
summary_sentence: Results are limited OSM place nodes, not a complete or official settlement list.
quick_answer: Enter a county name and optional two-letter state abbreviation. The Overpass query returns up to 300 mapped city, town or village nodes in matching administrative areas; results may be incomplete or ambiguous.
steps_intro: Counties contain more places than their famous city. List them all:

body.t: Explore mapped settlements as a starting point for coverage planning; verify membership and completeness independently. Related context:
The village an ancestor's record names may not be the county seat — the full list is where small places are findable at all.
Settlements with coordinates are a market's skeleton: plot them and the county's real shape replaces its outline.
Use the returned points as a starting list, not proof that every settlement has been covered.

examples.label: Example · Why the state code matters

body.t: County names may recur. A state code helps narrow the search, but missing or inconsistent OSM state tags can prevent a match.
Unincorporated communities may appear when mapped as a city, town or village node, but other tags are not included.

popular_table.title: What the list contains
popular_table.intro: Field by field — the settlement record as the finder returns it.
popular_table.note: Membership is by the county's mapped boundary: a settlement whose point falls inside is listed. Boundary-adjacent places can sit either side of different maps' lines.

faq: Only those mapped as city, town or village nodes in matching areas. Results are capped at 300 and are not complete.
The optional two-letter code filters by an OSM state tag, which may be missing or inconsistent; it does not guarantee a unique match.
Can I list a parish or borough?
The search appends County to the supplied name, so other county-equivalent naming conventions may not match.
The CSV includes returned names, latitude and longitude; it does not include place types or verified administrative membership.
